thread:
Maya R: Quick heads-up — I'm opening a refresh PR for the Ignite quickstart sample app. Main changes: migrate auth to SDK v2, standardize env var names (REDWOOD_API_KEY -> REDWOOD_KEY), and add a tiny CI deploy check that runs the sample app start. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/432. Can I get a couple of quick reviewers for snippets and the deploy step?

Liam T: Happy to review snippets. Can you paste the new auth snippet here so I can sanity-check usage and token placement?

Maya R: Sure — here's the node example I'm proposing (SDK v2):
```js
import Redwood from '@redwoodai/sdk'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })
const resp = await client.generate({ model: 'open-llama-7b', input: 'Hello from Ignite!' })
console.log(resp.text)
```
Notes: switched env var to REDWOOD_KEY to avoid collision with other services.

Jordan P: Looks fine. Two small asks: 1) Add a brief migration note in the top of the page explaining the env var rename + why (avoid accidental leaks). 2) Keep an example showing cURL for folks who aren't on node.

Maya R: Good call. cURL example below — using single quotes to keep it shell-friendly:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -d '{"model":"open-llama-7b","input":"Hello from Ignite via curl"}'
```

docs-bot: link-checker: I scanned the PR content and found one outdated external link: https://example.com/old-sdk referenced in docs/quickstarts/ignite.md line 72 — suggest replacing with https://example.com/sdk-v2 or removing.

Alex K: I'll take the link fix + add the migration note. One edge case: on Dedicated/Private installs team needs to keep REDWOOD_KEY in a vault; maybe add a short callout under "Deployment".

Sam W: Also, can we get one screenshot of the sample app's running UI + one of the Console route view? I can hunt these down and add. Small ask: ensure screenshots are 800px width max and under 200KB.

Maya R: Awesome — @Alex K please update the PR with the link fix, migration note, and the vault callout. @Sam W screenshots would be great. @Liam T would you do the snippet review and sanity-check the small code phrasing? Hoping to merge by EOD Friday.

Liam T: Will review tonight. Quick nit: in node snippet maybe show await inside try/catch so newbies see error handling. Suggest: `try { const r = await client.generate(...) } catch (e) { console.error(e) }`.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline "ignite-quickstart" failed on stage "start-sample-app" — error: PORT 3000 already in use. Full log: https://ci.internal.redwood/1234/logs

Maya R: Thanks deploy-bot. @Alex K can you reproduce locally? If this is flaky we should make the CI step use a random free port or kill any previous process.

Alex K: Reproduced — the test harness didn't clean up. Fixing the CI job to pick a random free port and use `lsof -ti:$PORT | xargs -r kill -9` before start. I'll push that to the PR shortly.

Maya R: Perfect. Once Alex pushes the CI fix and the link/migration edits are in, I'll merge after a quick LGTM from @Liam T. Thanks everyone :rocket:

Jordan P: One more tiny doc-UX thing: add a short "When to use Dedicated vs Hosted for Ignite" blurb. It can be a sentence or two; helps product folks.

Maya R: Will add that as a TODO in the PR description so we don't forget.

Liam T: LGTM on approach, will post inline comments.

Alex K: Pushed fixes (CI + link + migration blurb). PR updated: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/432/files

Maya R: Verified CI passed on the new run. Merging now. Thanks all — will follow up with a small changelog entry for the release notes. :tada:
